name: Sibtu

wants.text: Work for three more pairs of hands
wants.stake: Four children in a cousin’s room

wants.text: Not to be a burden on her cousin

fears: the children forgetting their father's house
contradiction: She asks for help and resents needing it.

provenance.notes: An invented displaced household. Local displacement for harvest failure or insecurity is plausible and not attributed to the later collapse.

voice.register: Terse, concrete, refuses pity. Speaks to the loom; uses the children to end a conversation.
tics: not looking up from the shuttle
sampleLines: Sit, if you can sit without being asked twice.
I cannot go to the yard myself without someone deciding I am for sale.
He is not dead. I would know.
